frequency_question: How often does a joint resolution of disapproval successfully pass both chambers and survive or override a presidential veto to block a major nuclear or arms agreement?
membership_rule: Includes all formal joint resolutions of disapproval introduced and brought to a vote regarding Section 123 peaceful nuclear cooperation agreements or major foreign military sales requiring congressional review.

cases.name: 1986 Sale of Missiles to Saudi Arabia
1988 Sale of Maverick Missiles to Saudi Arabia
2016 JASTA Override (Veto override, though different mechanism, included as legislative veto test)
2019 Iran Nuclear Agreement Review Act / Yemen / Arms Sales Disapproval Resolutions

provenance_note: claimed 0 hits but 1 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 5 named major high-stakes foreign policy disapproval resolution battles where votes reached the floor.
known_gaps: Minor non-binding or committee-killed resolutions are excluded as they never reached the floor for a final passage test.
validity_reason: The structural bicameralism and presentment requirements of the U.S. Constitution and the statutory mechanics of the AEA review process remain invariant over this horizon.
